exposure: time period of study (earlier vs. later years)
cohort: 201 pregnancies resulting in infants weighing ≥5.0 kg
finding: There was a significant increase in cesarean delivery rates in the later years of the study due to an increase in planned pre-labor cesarean deliveries, but no difference in adverse outcomes between the two time periods.
mod_finding: There was a significant increase in cesarean delivery rates in the later years of the study due to an increase in planned pre-labor cesarean deliveries.
